name: Multi-asset ETF book: 1/3 time-series trend, 1/3 risk parity, 1/3 bond trend-carry

rules.universe: 16 US-listed ETFs: SPY QQQ IWM EFA EEM TLT IEF SHY LQD HYG GLD SLV DBC USO UUP VNQ
rules.trend: 12-month time-series momentum per ETF, 60-day volatility scaling to 40 % per asset, 10 % portfolio target (Moskowitz, Ooi, Pedersen 2012)
rules.bond_trend_carry: 12-month trend and carry across the bond ETFs (Asness, Moskowitz, Pedersen 2013)
rules.book: 1/3 of capital to each component; monthly rebalance on the last weekday; next-bar execution; leverage cap 1 per component
rules.costs: 3 bps per side, 50 bps per year borrow; the gate also uses doubled costs

params: literature defaults, no parameter chosen from the data

data_manifest.source: daily adjusted closes of the 16 ETFs
